div.h1: Products table: page number lives in the URL
div.p: One hook reads and writes ?page, one pure function turns it into rows.

text.tspan: connects nuqs to the Next router
hook re-renders with the new page

ul.li: page from the URL is clamped to 1..pageCount (typing ?page=99 shows the last page)
?page=1 is removed from the URL (clearOnDefault), so the default view has a clean address
the component reading the URL sits inside Suspense: Next prerenders the page statically
buttons, not links: a full reload would drop products added in memory
